data_fields.name: objective_max_factor_letitdone
data_fields.donor_constant: ceil(Count x 1.5) when LetItDone (donor ceil; status checks use integer division)

data_fields.name: early_turn_in_fraction
data_fields.donor_constant: Count x 1/2 (integer division in status check)

best_idea: A contract with an early turn-in (30% at half progress), a full payout at target, and a 120% overachieved bonus, all computed as a pure function of the objective counters and paid through one ledger.
decision_why: The status ladder and ratios are plain numbers that fit bounties and contracts, but the integer-division quirk, the client-asserted talk and the untested early turn-in must not be copied.
acceptance: Server test: a count-2 LetItDone contract refuses turn-in at 0 of 2 kills, pays 30% of the pool at 1 of 2, 100% at 2 of 2, and 120% at 3 kills; a turn-in request from a player beyond the NPC's range is refused.
